summary: Package facade for database settings. Re-exports the BackendSpec/ParameterSpec primitives, BackendProfile and UrlParts, the DATABASES_REGISTRY with get_descriptor/get_settings_class/register, the twelve AuthProfile types from mountainash_auth_client, and the twenty per-backend *BackendProfile classes. Importing it imports every per-backend module, which registers each profile. A module __getattr__ maps the deprecated names BackendDescriptor and _Missing to BackendSpec and Missing with a DeprecationWarning.
extension_points: Add a backend by writing a per-backend module with a BackendSpec and a @register-decorated BackendProfile subclass, then importing it here so it registers at package import.
lifecycle_notes: Registration is an import side effect: any import of a core.settings submodule (e.g. core.factories importing core.settings.profile) executes this __init__ and registers all twenty backends.
Auth types are no longer defined locally; the former core.settings.auth module was removed and the twelve AuthProfile classes are re-exported from mountainash_auth_client.
BackendDescriptor and _Missing are deprecated aliases that emit DeprecationWarning.
documentation_hooks: Settings recipe: construct a *BackendProfile and pass an AuthProfile separately to IbisBackend.connect(auth_profile=...)
Table of the twenty registered backends with their supported auth types
Migration note: BackendDescriptor → BackendSpec, *AuthSettings → *BackendProfile, PasswordAuth → PasswordAuthProfile
risks: CLAUDE.md is stale against this surface: it names BackendDescriptor/ProfileDescriptor, ConnectionProfile with to_driver_kwargs()/to_connection_string(), AuthSpec subclasses (PasswordAuth, OAuth2Auth, IAMAuth) re-exported from mountainash_settings.auth, and SQLiteAuthSettings/PostgreSQLAuthSettings/NoAuth usage. The code exports BackendSpec, BackendProfile (no auth methods), *BackendProfile classes and *AuthProfile types from mountainash_auth_client.
Importing any settings submodule eagerly imports all twenty backend modules; a broken backend module breaks every settings import.
open_questions: Should CLAUDE.md's Settings section and usage example be corrected to the BackendProfile/AuthProfile API before textbook regeneration?
